lab_title: Exploring the Anatomy of the Human Heart
top_level_objectives: Identify the four chambers of the heart and their functions
Understand the structure and role of the heart valves
Describe the path of blood flow through the heart and major vessels
Explain the differences in myocardium thickness between heart chambers and its physiological significance

scenes.brief_purpose: To familiarize students with the heart's anatomy and major structures.
student_actions: Rotate the heart model to view all sides
Tap on various parts to learn their names and functions

scenes.brief_purpose: To identify and explore the four chambers of the heart.
key_visuals: Close-up view of the four heart chambers
Highlighted right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, left ventricle
student_actions: Select each chamber to view detailed descriptions and functions
Learn about blood flow through each chamber

scenes.brief_purpose: To examine the four valves of the heart and their importance in blood flow.
key_visuals: Labels for tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, and aortic valves
student_actions: Interact with the valves to see how they open and close
Simulate blood flow through the valves during the cardiac cycle

scenes.brief_purpose: To identify the major blood vessels associated with the heart.
key_visuals: Labels for vena cava, pulmonary arteries, veins, and aorta
student_actions: Trace the path of blood flow in and out of the heart
Click on vessels to learn their functions in circulation

scenes.brief_purpose: To visualize and understand the dual-loop circulation driven by the heart.
key_visuals: Animated diagram of systemic and pulmonary circulation
student_actions: Follow the blood flow from body to lungs and back to the body
Engage with pop-up information about oxygenation and deoxygenation

scenes.brief_purpose: To explore the differences in muscle thickness between heart chambers.
key_visuals: Cross-sectional view of heart with myocardium layers
Comparison of left and right ventricle musculature
student_actions: Measure the myocardium thickness in each chamber
Learn why the left ventricle is thicker and its physiological implications

scenes.brief_purpose: To understand the function of valves in preventing backflow during the cardiac cycle.
key_visuals: Animation showing the cardiac cycle phases
Illustration of valve positions during each phase
student_actions: Analyze how valves open and close during contraction and relaxation
Simulate a cardiac cycle and observe valve actions

scenes.brief_purpose: To consolidate learning and assess understanding of heart anatomy and function.
key_visuals: Summary of key points covered in the lab
student_actions: Answer quiz questions based on lab content
Review areas of difficulty to enhance understanding
